text:
tasha: Quick readout from CedarPoint POC run earlier today. Ran a mixed-chat+embed profile they asked for (65/35). Posting config, headline numbers, and follow-ups.

devon: thanks — paste the harness and the rough cost so I can update the quote.

tasha: test config: model=gptx-13b-6k-quant, infra=dedicated-2xH100, concurrency target=140, batch_target=14, kv_cache=on, prefix_cache=enabled for session reuse. runner=custom go client + k6 ramp that mirrors their daily traffic curve.

jules: did you hit their 300ms p95 requirement for non-embedding interactive endpoints?

tasha: short version: no on the baseline run. details:
- traffic: poisson baseline qps=110, peak sustained=130, microbursts to 280 qps for 20s every 8m
- chat avg tokens out=180, embeddings=sea-embed-small
- 45m steady run results:
  - sustained throughput achieved: 110 qps stable
  - chat end-to-end p50=270ms, p95=620ms
  - embeddings p95=165ms
  - error rate during bursts: 3.8% (timeouts/retries)
  - GPU avg util=68%, memory headroom ~10GB
  - rough hosted-equivalent cost: $0.55 / 1k chat tokens (incl. infra amortization)

leena: 620ms p95 is above their 300ms ask. Any idea where the tail came from?

tasha: root causes we saw: burst queueing at ingress, a handful of long RTs from 2 workers showing kernel stall patterns, and a cold prefix cache on some prompt variants.

devon: actionable mitigations? Need to know engineering effort vs quick config toggles for the deal.

tasha: low-effort steps to try first: 1) enable request-level prewarm for their top-200 conversational prompts (priming), 2) drop batch_target to 12 for windowed bursts, 3) enable one-shot short-lived burst worker policy (scale +1 when qps>150 for 90s). Ops-bot created an autoscale task.

ops-bot: [automated] autoscale suggestion created: TASK-912233 by tasha. Policy: +1 worker when 1m avg qps >150, cooldown 2m. link: https://console.redwood.example/rb/912233

jules: and medium-effort? If that doesn't hit 300ms p95.

tasha: medium-effort: kernel parameter tuning for attention kernels (eng-runtime), and investigate worker process jitter — could be a model layout mismatch causing slow kernels on rare sequences. That would need a 2-3 day eng-runtime slot.

leena: Dev on pricing — if we add the burst worker policy, what's the delta?

tasha: estimate +$2.1k/mo to reserve spare capacity for bursts, plus a small incremental on-request charge. I'll give precise delta after next run.

devon: please run the primed + batch=12 experiment and capture CSV + flame graphs. We need numbers for the proposal.

tasha: running now. k6 snippet used for the chat mix is below: 

```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';

export default function () {
  const body = JSON.stringify({ model: 'gptx-13b-6k-quant', prompt: 'Answer concisely', max_tokens: 200 });
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat', body, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer REDACTED' } });
  sleep(Math.random() * 0.15);
}
```

ops-bot: deploy job started (TASK-912233) by tasha at 3200000145

tasha: quick follow-up (3200000180) after primed run (20m focused on bursts):
- chat p95 dropped to 305ms (very close to target)
- p50=240ms
- embeddings p95 unchanged ~160ms
- burst drop rate down to 0.9%
- kernel stall traces reduced after priming but still see two slow tail traces at ~2min intervals
- new cost delta estimate for proposal: +$2.1k/mo for reserved burst buffer, one-time perf tuning optional add-on (eng-runtime) = ~$6k retainer if they want kernel tuning included

jules: 305ms p95 is negotiable. We'll present priming + burst buffer as the recommended baseline and keep kernel tuning as an optional paid engineering engagement.

leena: CedarPoint security asked about KMS and audit retention. Can we commit to customer-managed KMS for Private and audit log export for Dedicated?

tasha: yes for Private. For Dedicated we offer envelope encryption with customer KMS integration on request and audit export to their SIEM; I'll patch a 3-line answer for the questionnaire.

devon: please upload the perf CSV, flame graphs, and a short executive summary to the deal folder so sales ops can attach to the SOW.

tasha: uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/cedarpoint/perf/3200000123-report.zip contains CSV, flame graphs, and the run configs.

ops-bot: note: TASK-912233 completed at 3200000178

jules: next steps checklist: 1) attach perf ZIP to proposal (devon) 2) update pricing sheet with +$2.1k/mo and optional $6k tuning (leena) 3) paste KMS/audit blurb into security questionnaire (tasha) 4) if CedarPoint insists on <300ms p95, open eng-runtime ticket (jules).

leena: will do pricing update now.

devon: grabbing the ZIP and will add to the SOW. thanks team.

tasha: will draft the KMS blurb and drop it here by EOD. Closing thread unless anyone needs more data. :white_check_mark:
